notes: Minifigure parts (head, torso, legs, helmet, visor) are shown on page 2 but are not in the parts list, so they are not included.

Chassis is built upside down in the manual (round plates and wheel holders attached to the 2x6 plate's underside); rests_on follows build order: round plates clutch the 2x6, wheel holders clutch the round plates.
Each end of the 2x6 carries a light grey 1x2 plate on one row and a side-handle plate (2540, the exhaust pipes) on the other; the mudguard sits on both.
Left mudguard (b10) carries two white jumpers; the slope (b16) and clip tile (b17) sit on their studs. Right mudguard (b11) carries the grille tile and one jumper holding the antenna flagpole.
Handlebars, flag, wheels and tyres are joined by pins/clips, not by resting; their rests_on is empty.
Exact placement of 2540 vs 3023 on the 2x6 ends and the grille tile/jumper arrangement is inferred from small illustrations.
